basis: test_solver_parity.py maximum load nRMSE bound; comparison envelope is twice that bound
input_basis: Uniform string and SI properties from test_deviation_survey.py; static speed is harmonic speed multiplied by the stated fraction. Synthetic boundary conditions are defined in test_solver_analytical.py.
tolerance_basis: Position uses the existing 0.2% parity position bound. Static load uses the same relative bound. Harmonic load allows 1% for the first-order pump strain on a 149-interval spatial grid; no tolerance will be fitted to an observed result.
